export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/propix-technologies-private-limited) shows Propix as SUPPLIER on an outbound lane: "2026-02-12 | PROPIX TECHNOLOGIES PRIVATE LIMITED | DILMAH CEYLON TEA COMPANY PLC | LEVEL 3 CLOUD SOFTWARE (SAAS)- | SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC INBOM4, India | COLOMBO, Sri Lanka | 90314900 | 9603601". This is a dated export record with destination (Colombo, Sri Lanka), HS 90314900 and B/L no. 9603601. Counter vs rows actually seen: page header states "Total Shipments 174 Records detected", "Trading Partners 15", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-12"; only 5 shipment rows were rendered in the free view, of which exactly 1 is an export (Propix as supplier) and 4 are imports into India (Propix as buyer). So 1 of 174 rows verified; the remaining 173 are behind the paywall and were NOT seen.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic split could be retrieved. Searches for domestic supply evidence returned no usable page (search backend returned connection errors; Google/DDG HTML endpoints blocked or timed out). The ImportKey page shows only customs records, not domestic GST turnover. No domestic supply record was seen — this is a data-access gap, not a finding of absence.
note: Export side is genuinely confirmed, not merely declared: one dated outbound customs record (2026-02-12, India -> Colombo Sri Lanka, HS 90314900, B/L 9603601) with Propix as supplier to Dilmah Ceylon Tea Company PLC. Caveat on the declared HS: the claimed code 903180 does not match the observed export line, which is 90314900 (measuring/checking instruments, other) — same 4-digit heading 9031, so the declared code is a plausible but not exact match; per project rules this is not a rejection ground, the actual code should be recorded as 90314900 for the export line. The company's trade profile is predominantly IMPORT (4 of 5 visible rows are inbound: ink cartridges from Docod/Shanghai HS 84439952, power adapters from Shenzhen/Hong Kong HS 85284900, printing accessories from Fam Srl Italy HS 84433990, inkjet cartridges from Malaysia HS 84439952) — i.e. it looks like an importer/assembler of coding-and-marking and touch/display equipment that also re-exports software/services, consistent with a manufacturer_trader role rather than a pure manufacturer. Domestic supply status is unknown only because no GST/tender source was reachable within the tool budget; it should be re-checked against GST portal or GeM before any final verdict. Revenue and export volume figures: null — not public on the free view, not invented.
